question_text: In Edwin Hubble's classification system, what does the number in elliptical galaxy designations (E0 through E7) represent?
hint: Think about the shape and appearance of these galaxies

options: The galaxy's ellipticity (how round vs. elongated it appears)
The galaxy's age in billions of years
The number of spiral arms the galaxy originally had
The galaxy's distance from Earth in millions of light-years
